tips.label: 情緒動詞
tips.text: 事物 + 情緒動詞 + 人：The news surprised me.

tips.label: 分詞形容詞
tips.text: -ing 表示令人感到；-ed 表示感到。人也可能是 interesting，要看意思。

tips.label: so…that…
tips.text: so + 形容詞／副詞 + that + 完整句子。

tips.label: enough…to…
tips.text: 形容詞／副詞 + enough + (for 人) + to 原形動詞。

tips.label: too…to…
tips.text: too + 形容詞／副詞 + (for 人) + to 原形動詞：太……而不能……。

tips.label: 省略重複受詞
tips.text: The tea is too hot to drink. 不加 it；play with 的 with 要保留。

notes.title: 情緒動詞與分詞形容詞
notes.rule: 事物 + 情緒動詞 + 人；主詞 + be／連綴動詞 + 分詞形容詞
notes.description: interest、excite、bore、surprise、touch、tire、scare 可表示使人產生某種感受。-ing 描述造成感受的來源，-ed 描述感受者；不可死背成人用 -ed、物用 -ing。
examples: This web page interests me a lot.（這個網頁讓我很感興趣。）
The talk show is interesting.（那個談話節目很有趣。）
Fred is an interesting person.（弗瑞德是個有趣的人。）
I feel bored.（我感到無聊。）

notes.title: 常見變化與名詞前的用法
notes.description: 其他配對：touching/touched、tiring/tired、worrying/worried。令人害怕的用 scary，感到害怕的用 scared。分詞形容詞也能放在名詞前。
examples: All the excited fans are waiting for the singer.（所有興奮的歌迷都在等那位歌手。）
That is surprising news.（那是令人驚訝的消息。）
Birds are scary to Sara.（鳥類對莎拉來說很可怕。）

notes.title: 情緒形容詞的搭配
notes.rule: interested in；excited about；bored with；surprised at/by；touched by；scared of；worried about
notes.description: 介系詞後接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing。令人感到的形容詞可用 to + 人，如 boring to me。若上下文已清楚指出對象，可省略介系詞和受詞。這些搭配供學習，不單獨作介系詞選擇題。
examples: Leonard is interested in pop music.（雷納德對流行音樂感興趣。）
Haley is excited about going to the party.（海莉對要去派對感到興奮。）
Math is boring to me.（數學對我來說很無聊。）

notes.title: 不定詞與 tired、worry
notes.rule: surprised／excited + to V；tired of 與 tired from
notes.description: surprised to learn 表示得知某事而驚訝。tired of 表示厭倦，tired from 表示因做某事而疲累。worry 可表示擔心，也可表示使人擔心。
examples: I was surprised to learn that I got 100 on my test.（得知考試拿到一百分，我很驚訝。）
Daniel got tired of his job.（丹尼爾對工作感到厭倦。）
Patrick was tired from cleaning the house.（派翠克因為打掃房子而感到疲累。）
Don't worry about Kate.（別擔心凱特。）
The heavy rain worries me.（這場大雨令我擔憂。）

notes.title: so…that… 表示結果
notes.rule: 主詞 + 動詞 + so + 形容詞／副詞 + that + 主詞 + 動詞
notes.description: that 後面是完整子句。be 或連綴動詞後用形容詞；修飾一般動詞的方式通常用副詞。
examples: The pie smells so good that I want to take a bite.（這個派聞起來很棒，讓我想咬一口。）
Vincent cried so loudly that I could hear him in my room.（文森哭得很大聲，我在房間裡都聽得到。）

notes.title: so 的其他用法
notes.rule: so = 很；so 代替前述內容；so = 所以
notes.description: The cake is so delicious. 的 so 表程度。I think so. 的 so 代替前述看法。連接詞 so 表結果，與 so…that… 的句型不同。
examples: The cake is so delicious.（這個蛋糕很好吃。）
A: Will Jane like this dress? B: I think so.（甲：珍會喜歡這件洋裝嗎？乙：我想會。）
I didn't eat breakfast this morning, so I'm hungry now.（我今天早上沒吃早餐，所以現在很餓。）

notes.title: enough…to… 與否定
notes.rule: 形容詞／副詞 + enough + (for 人) + to 原形動詞
notes.description: enough 放在形容詞或副詞後面；for 後接受格，如 me、him、her、us、them。not…enough to… 表示程度不足。一般動詞的否定用 did not／does not 等助動詞。
examples: We are tall enough to get the book.（我們夠高，可以拿到那本書。）
The shirt is not big enough for Frank to wear.（這件襯衫不夠大，法蘭克穿不下。）
Susan didn't study hard enough to get good grades.（蘇珊不夠用功，沒能得到好成績。）

notes.title: too…to…
notes.rule: too + 形容詞／副詞 + (for 人) + to 原形動詞
notes.description: too…to… 本身含有不能做到的意思，不再加入 cannot。人不同時用 for + 人指出動作執行者。
examples: Leo came too late to watch the game.（里歐來得太晚，沒看到比賽。）
The haunted house is too scary for Lisa to visit.（那個鬼屋太嚇人了，麗莎不敢去參觀。）

notes.title: 省略重複受詞，保留必要介系詞
notes.rule: 主詞與不定詞受詞相同 → 不再寫 it／them
notes.description: The tea is too hot to drink. 的 drink 受詞就是 the tea，不再加 it。play with 的 with 不能省略。若受詞與句子主詞不同，仍要保留。
examples: The toy is not safe enough to play with.（這個玩具不夠安全，不能玩。）
Amy is too young to ride a scooter.（艾咪太年輕了，不能騎機車。）

notes.title: 三種句型互換
notes.rule: too short to… = so short that…cannot… = not tall enough to…
notes.description: 改寫須保留原意：注意反義詞、否定和時態。so…that… 用完整子句，原本省略的受詞可能需要補回。過去的能力不足用 could not。
examples: Kelly is too short to reach the shelf.（凱莉太矮，摸不到架子。）
Kelly is so short that she can't reach the shelf.（凱莉很矮，以致於摸不到架子。）
Kelly is not tall enough to reach the shelf.（凱莉不夠高，摸不到架子。）
The sentence is not easy enough for me to understand. = The sentence is so hard that I can't understand it.（句子太難，我看不懂。）

quiz.question: The movie looks ___. I can't wait to watch it!
quiz.hint: 電影是引起興奮的來源；looks 後接形容詞 exciting。

quiz.question: Judy is ___ in making online videos.
quiz.hint: Judy 是感興趣的人，is 後用 interested。

quiz.question: The actor's long speech made us sleepy. It was ___.
quiz.hint: 演講令人無聊，用 boring 描述造成感受的來源。

quiz.question: I felt ___ with the online game, so I stopped playing.
quiz.hint: I 是感到無聊的人；felt 後接 bored。

quiz.question: The actress was ___ by the lovely card.
quiz.hint: 女演員受到卡片感動，用過去分詞形容詞 touched。

quiz.question: What a ___ story! It touched my heart.
quiz.hint: story 是令人感動的來源，名詞前用 touching。

quiz.question: The fans were ___ about meeting the actor.
quiz.hint: fans 是感到興奮的人，用 excited。

quiz.question: The news about the castle was ___ to us.
quiz.hint: 消息使我們驚訝，用 surprising 描述 news。

quiz.question: I was ___ to learn that the newspaper story was fake.
quiz.hint: I 是得知消息後感到驚訝的人，用 surprised。

quiz.question: Digging this big hole is ___. Let's take a rest.
quiz.hint: 挖洞這件事令人疲累，用 tiring。

quiz.question: After digging for two hours, Ben felt ___.
quiz.hint: Ben 是感到疲累的人，felt 後接 tired。

quiz.question: My sister is ___ of bats and ghosts.
quiz.hint: 妹妹感到害怕，用 scared；scary 表示令人害怕。

quiz.question: The ghost is ___ to my little brother. He won't go near it.
quiz.hint: 鬼對弟弟而言令人害怕，用 scary to 人；scared 表示感到害怕，不能搭配此處的 to 人。

quiz.question: Mom is ___ about my little brother because he is sick.
quiz.hint: 媽媽是感到擔心的人，用 worried。

quiz.question: Fred's funny stories are ___ to everyone in our class.
quiz.hint: 故事使大家覺得有趣，用 interesting to 人；interested 描述感興趣的人。

quiz.question: The video ___ me every time I watch it.
quiz.hint: 空格後有受詞 me，需用情緒動詞；every time 表習慣，單數主詞用 excites。

quiz.question: The fake post ___ everyone yesterday.
quiz.hint: 空格後直接接 everyone，需用情緒動詞；yesterday 提示過去式 surprised。

quiz.question: My brother is interested in ___ sentences in English.
quiz.hint: in 是介系詞，後面的動作須用 V-ing：writing。

quiz.question: We are excited about ___ tickets online.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 about 後面用動名詞 booking。

quiz.question: I was surprised ___ the actress at the castle.
quiz.hint: surprised 可接 to + 原形動詞，表示因看到某人而驚訝。

quiz.question: The movie was ___ funny that everyone laughed.
quiz.hint: 後面接 that 完整子句，形容詞 funny 前用 so。

quiz.question: The actor spoke so quickly ___ I couldn't understand him.
quiz.hint: so + 副詞後用 that 引出結果子句。

quiz.question: The girl sang so ___ that everyone stopped to listen.
quiz.hint: 空格修飾一般動詞 sang，須用副詞 beautifully。

quiz.question: The pie smells so ___ that I want a piece.
quiz.hint: smells 是連綴動詞，描述派的氣味用形容詞原級 good；so 後不用比較級或最高級。

quiz.question: The online post was so touching that it ___ me cry.
quiz.hint: that 後是完整子句；it 後需有動詞，依 was 用過去式 made。

quiz.question: The box was so heavy that I ___ lift it. I had to ask Dad for help.
quiz.hint: 箱子太重而需要爸爸幫忙，結果是過去無法搬動，用 couldn't。

quiz.question: The ghost was so scary that ___ ran away.
quiz.hint: that 後需完整子句，ran 前的主詞用主格 we。

quiz.question: This sentence is so difficult that I can't understand ___.
quiz.hint: understand 需要受詞，指回 this sentence 用受格 it。

quiz.question: The towel is ___ for me to use now. It is no longer wet.
quiz.hint: enough 修飾形容詞時放在後面：dry enough。

quiz.question: My sister is old enough ___ her own hair.
quiz.hint: enough 後接 to + 原形動詞，表示程度足夠可以做某事。

quiz.question: The actor spoke ___ for everyone to hear him clearly.
quiz.hint: 修飾 spoke 用副詞 loudly；enough 放在副詞後。

quiz.question: The sentence is easy enough for ___ to understand.
quiz.hint: for 是介系詞，指定動作執行者時後接受格 me。

quiz.question: The girl is strong enough to ___ this heavy box.
quiz.hint: to 不定詞後接原形動詞 carry。

quiz.question: The boy is only five. He is ___ to see this movie; viewers must be eighteen.
quiz.hint: 五歲未達十八歲門檻，須用 not old enough 表示年齡不足。

quiz.question: Sam didn't run ___ to catch the bus.
quiz.hint: didn't run fast enough to 表示跑得不夠快，未能趕上公車。

quiz.question: The tickets are cheap enough for us ___ two.
quiz.hint: for us 指執行者，後面接 to + 原形動詞 buy。

quiz.question: The book is simple enough for my sister to ___ by herself.
quiz.hint: read 的受詞與主詞 The book 相同，不重複加 it；to 後用原形。

quiz.question: The toy is safe enough to play ___.
quiz.hint: play with 的 with 要保留；受詞就是主詞 The toy，因此不加 it。

quiz.question: The tea is ___ hot to drink. Please wait a minute.
quiz.hint: 需等待降溫表示太燙而不能喝，用 too…to…。

quiz.question: We arrived ___ late to book a room. All the rooms were full.
quiz.hint: 沒有房間可訂表示到得太晚，用 too late to…。

quiz.question: The ghost is too scary for Lisa ___ at.
quiz.hint: too…for 人…後接 to + 原形動詞；look at 的 at 已在句尾。

quiz.question: The ticket is too expensive for ___ to buy.
quiz.hint: for 後接受格 him；這裡沒有與主詞同指的反身關係。

quiz.question: I am too tired ___ the answer right now.
quiz.hint: too tired 後接 to + 原形動詞 guess。

quiz.question: This piece of cake is too big for me to ___.
quiz.hint: finish 的受詞就是主詞 This piece of cake，不再加 it。

quiz.question: The castle is too far away for us to ___ today.
quiz.hint: too…to… 的 to 後用原形動詞 visit。

quiz.question: Nobody could lift the box because it was ___ to move.
quiz.hint: Nobody could lift 提示無法搬動；too heavy to move 表示太重而搬不動。

quiz.question: Kelly is too short to reach the shelf. She is not ___ to reach it.
quiz.hint: too short 改成 not…enough 時用反義詞 tall，enough 放在 tall 後。

quiz.question: The sentence is too hard for me to understand. It is so hard that I ___ understand it.
quiz.hint: too…to… 含不能之意，轉成 so…that… 時需用 can't 表結果。

quiz.question: Mary was so tired that she couldn't walk farther. She was ___ to walk farther.
quiz.hint: so tired that…couldn't 可改為 too tired to，保留無法繼續走的原意。

quiz.question: The box is light enough for Ben to carry. It is so light that Ben ___ carry it.
quiz.hint: light enough to carry 表示輕到可以搬，改成結果子句用 can。
